correctness.rationale: The removable-ear argument enumerates every connected outerplanar type through order eight. Direct color refinement and full automorphism enumeration find four exceptions among the 777 eight-vertex types. An independent all-connected-parents augmentation (853 parents, 108331 attachments, 5841 outerplanar positives, 777 isomorphism types) and pointed-isomorphism orbit test confirm the same four structural signatures; no smaller exceptions. Published connected-outerplanar coefficient 777 is an external census check. Each exception has an explicit edge set and equitable refinement quotient. The claim is strictly finite.

originality.rationale: The 2015 definitional refinability framework and 2005 outerplanar generating-function enumeration do not determine the stable-partition failures in the connected or biconnected outerplanar family. Two cactus exceptions overlap a narrower previously analyzed subfamily, but the two biconnected exceptions are beyond it and yield an exact, naturally delimited sharp classification. No matching or stronger small-order outerplanar orbit-refinement classification was found by source or equivalence searches; specialized tables remain a residual risk.

value.rationale: This sharp first biconnected outerplanar failure threshold identifies the precise obstruction to orbit recovery by two-variable counting descriptions at the first possible graph order. The complete four-type census in a classical two-parameter structural graph family goes beyond isolated witnesses and distinguishes the cactus and biconnected mechanisms. It is a natural bounded invariant classification, not a generic small graph exercise, and the precise biconnected boundary can be used to calibrate structural refinability theories.
